description: Single-strand roller-chain sprocket per ISO 606 / DIN 8187: toothed disc (ISO 606 §8.2 tooth form), heterogeneous hub variants from the catalog Form column (A = one-sided boss, B = straight barrel with larger bores), center bore, DIN 6885A keyway on hard tier. Reference design for the table-driven pattern + the shared geomlib inlining mechanism.
source: norelem 22250 datasheet (single sprockets 5/8" x 3/8" DIN ISO 606, ready to install) — see NOTES.md for the symbol mapping; ISO 606 Table 1 + §8.2 tooth equations; DIN 6885-1 Form A key seats
